builder_plan.scenario: Profiling shows attention computation is a bottleneck in your self-hosted service.
builder_plan.change: Check the supported GPU, tensor shapes, and precision, then replace only the relevant kernel.
builder_plan.baseline: The existing kernel inside the same complete serving pipeline.
steps: Locate the paper's implementation and check its license, model support, data needs, and hardware requirements. Stop here if you cannot obtain the required artifacts.
Save a small set of representative product tasks and expected outcomes. Keep evaluation tasks out of any training or tuning, and choose quality and cost limits before running.
Run the baseline and the proposed change on identical inputs. Keep other settings fixed and repeat paired runs to expose variation.
Save per-task outputs, failures, timings, and all usage costs. Review regressions before expanding the test.
builder_plan.measure: Numerical differences, end-to-end latency, throughput, and memory at realistic shapes.
builder_plan.decision: Keep the change only if it meets your preselected quality and latency limits and improves the metric you care about after setup and operating costs. Otherwise retain the baseline. This is an exploration plan, not a validated recommendation.

title: Causal Attention on CPU: A Cache-Aware and Load-Balanced Scheduling Kernel for Prefill
summary: CACPU replaces GPU-based causal attention prefilling with a CPU kernel featuring tiered cache blocking and in-kernel task dispatching for multi-agent long-context workloads. It requires CPU memory capacity for long-context KV cache and adds integration complexity via SGLang; the causal attention pattern limits applicability to prefill rather than general decoding. Performance depends on specific CPU cache hierarchies and thread counts, and CPU memory bandwidth may bottleneck very long sequences or high concurrency compared to GPU.
rationale: Relevant for offloading prefill from saturated GPUs to CPUs in multi-agent serving, but gains are workload- and hardware-dependent and require SGLang adoption and validation.
technique: Cache-aware CPU attention kernel for prefill

claims.statement: CACPU replaces GPU-based causal attention prefilling with a CPU kernel featuring tiered cache blocking and in-kernel task dispatching for multi-agent long-context workloads. It requires CPU memory capacity for long-context KV cache and adds integration complexity via SGLang; the causal attention pattern limits applicability to prefill rather than general decoding. Performance depends on specific CPU cache hierarchies and thread counts, and CPU memory bandwidth may bottleneck very long sequences or high concurrency compared to GPU.
Up to 2.01x speedup over PyTorch SDPA, FlexAttention, and SGLang attention kernels; reduces TTFT of Llama-3.1-8B by up to 1.74x when integrated into SGLang.
